duplicate_support_review.official_metadata_explanation: All duplicate supports are official TourismLarge grouped-hierarchy nodes from different tags levels. Six all-purpose Zone nodes share support with their corresponding single Region nodes; their four Purpose children also share one-bottom support with corresponding Region/Purpose nodes.
duplicate_support_review.edge_policy: Edges remain derived only from S_df support inclusion. Series names and official tag levels are used only to audit/explain duplicate supports. Equal supports are not treated as parent/child; no node is deleted, merged, renamed, or selected by arbitrary tie-break.
